label: AMIES cumulative lithography tools of any type, company-counted delivery milestone
definition: AMIES's own cumulative count of lithography/exposure tools of any type (wafer-level and panel-level advanced-packaging steppers, LED/compound-semiconductor and flat-panel-display exposure tools) delivered to customers, continuing the milestone series SMEE began before AMIES's Feb 2025 spin-off; not separable by product family or category child.
